Require complete member payloads and timestamps

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The PowerSupplies GET supports the Items branch, but cannot satisfy the conflicting Fans procedure and is incomplete and credential-unsafe even for PSU validation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After owner scope resolution, use protected full collection/member retrieval plus synchronized UI evidence for the approved PSU or fan target; do not execute both merely to hide the conflict.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 10/10-minute estimates and all conflicting Master wording remain preserved; no state-changing operation is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record the scope decision and produce a per-member ledger with stable resource identity, physical location, required identity/telemetry, timestamp, health/status, redundancy role and SPEC result, retaining full raw payloads.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the PSU-versus-Fans conflict explicit and turns a generic display check into deterministic, topology-aware evidence after approval.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Four PSU fields neither cover complete PSU acceptance nor any fan acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Labels may be duplicated, aggregate objects may hide individual members and cached UI can mask missing or failed hardware; interpretation requires vendor semantics and physical mapping.

project_override_considerations: The Project must resolve the source scope and publish the selected population, physical mapping, fields and redundancy rules. Physical removal, power-feed manipulation, fan control or fault injection is outside this inventory-only row.
expected_evidence: Written PSU-versus-Fans scope ruling and exact target identity
Approved selected member/physical/field/redundancy matrix and vendor schema
Complete protected raw collection/member payloads and synchronized UI capture
Per-member comparison including missing, extra, duplicate, stale, unavailable and malformed states
No-control-mutation proof plus preserved audit, SEL and health evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items names Power supplies and DeepSeek queries PowerSupplies, while Procedure explicitly says check Fans. These are different hardware populations with different fields and safety meaning; neither branch may silently override the other.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The source conflict and selected SPEC are normal owner inputs. Execution becomes blocked only if the owner cannot resolve scope or complete safe evidence cannot be obtained after the normal request.

engineering_decision_request.question: Resolve whether Functionality row 1625 validates Power supplies as stated by Items and the DeepSeek resource, Fans as stated by Procedure, or separately accepted checkpoints; define the authoritative collection/UI target, complete PSU-or-fan member/physical/status matrix and disposition while preserving Master.

review_improvement: Prevents a four-field PSU read from falsely satisfying either side of a material PSU/Fans source conflict and defines safe complete evidence after owner resolution.
independent_technical_reasoning: PSU and fan inventories are not interchangeable: PSU acceptance depends on fitted bays, input feeds, capacity and redundancy, whereas fan acceptance depends on rotor mapping, speed, units and thermal thresholds. Running a plausible endpoint cannot decide the intended contract; the owner must select or separate the scopes before any comparison has engineering meaning.
